scope: The block and Leios header decoders of the build the public Leios testnet runs (release rc-2026w44): a block as BlockFetch carries it, [tag, block], read with the envelope of decodeDiskHfcBlock (tag 8 a ledger Block of the Leios header at Dijkstra's decoder version 12, tag 7 a Conway Block of the Praos header at 9), and a Leios header alone with decodeFullAnnotator at 12; the testnet's blocks, those blocks with each list definite, indefinite, detached (an empty indefinite list with the fields after it) or of the wrong length, the certificates in several forms, the certificate's signature of the wrong length, off the curve, outside the subgroup, not compressed and the identity, a tag-7 Conway block with a Praos header and with a Leios header, synthetic transactions with an output value in each form, and Leios headers in the forms of the header decoding oracle; for each accepted case the header hash, size, signed bytes and fields, the block body hash and size, each transaction's id and validity flag and which certificates the body holds; no rule, signature or certificate is checked; and each transaction alone as decodeDijkstraTopTxInBlock reads it at version 12 (#750): the transactions of the captured blocks of both networks, and synthetic transactions with one field changed at each decoder's boundary (each required body field missing, unknown and repeated keys, wrong types, empty collections, duplicates by value or hash, definite, indefinite, detached, tagged and chunked forms, outputs, values, datums and reference scripts, certificates with the pool voting key, votes, proposals and every Dijkstra parameter update key, sub-transactions, guards, deposits and balance intervals, witness sets with Plutus V4, redeemers and datums, auxiliary data); for each accepted transaction its id, validity flag, the keys of its witness set's script and datum maps and its sub-transactions; decoded redeemer map entries, including duplicate purposes retaining the last value and map key ordering

packageSources: cardano-ledger and cardano-base packages built from the pinned revisions (source-repository-package, as the node's cabal.project); cborg and plutus from Hackage and CHaP at the node's index-state

leiosHeader.note: the header body is memoized and signed over its original bytes (164-165); HeaderBody and HeaderRaw are read by decodeRecordNamed (308-344)

ledgerBlock.note: BlockHeaderVersionInfo, two Word32 not validated, and EbReferencesAnnouncement, both decodeRecordNamed (147-166, 184-189)

dijkstraBlockBody.note: the body of three, decodeSeq of the transactions and the nullable certificates (191-208); its hash over its original bytes (120)

maryValue.note: decodeValuePair: decodeRecordNamed from decoder version 12, the RecD record below it (308-321)

decCBOR.note: OutputVRF of the VRF's size and CertifiedVRF by decodeRecordNamed from version 12 (627-652); LeiosCert (721-736)

decoder.note: decodeRecordNamed and decodeListLikeT (645-700); decodeBytes and decodeByteArray take chunked strings from version 12 (359-364, 1388-1394)

coders.note: decodeCount (RecD cn) n is unchanged (482); the decoders of a Leios block do not reach it at version 12

cardanoNode.note: decodeDiskHfcBlock: enforceSize 2, decodeWord, tag 7 Conway and 8 Dijkstra (185-198); the harness's cardanoBlock writes those lines out for tags 7 and 8

cardanoEras.note: Conway is ShelleyBlock (Praos c), Dijkstra ShelleyBlock (Praos2 c) (269-278)

blsSignature.note: rawDecodeFixedSized of a signature: decompression and the subgroup check, the identity not excluded (476-491)

dijkstraTxBody.note: decodeSparseKeyed of the top and sub-transaction bodies, required fields, failOnNull, sub-transactions and required guards (340-479); decodeGuards (1662-1678)

dijkstraScripts.note: plutus purposes 0 to 6 (146-182), native scripts with the guard (295-325), account balance intervals (684-696)

dijkstraPParams.note: DijkstraPParams and eraPParams: update keys 0 to 56

alonzoTxWits.note: the witness set, datums and redeemers at version 12 (344-357, 566-700, 759-769)

conwayProcedures.note: voters, votes, proposals and governance actions at version 12

stakePool.note: BlsKey (538-542), relays (458-472), decodeStakePoolParamsFlat with the voting key slot (744-770)

baseTypes.note: BoundedRatio from version 12 (407-428), Url and DnsName (679-698), Anchor (1003-1011)
